blocks.text: Good question, and good to hear it early. Short answer: yes.

A signed inspection is never edited. If something needs fixing, the inspector makes a new inspection that points back to the first one, and the PDF says so: the correction names the inspection it corrects, and the original stays exactly as it was signed.
We'll put the PDF part in the middle so your auditor doesn't sit through setup, and I'm happy to show a correction live on Friday.
